definitions.attempt_firing: Issue code appears at least once in one attempt.
definitions.repair_opportunity: Issue code precedes another attempt and therefore could target the next deterministic or model repair.
definitions.resolved_after_repair: Target code is absent from the next attempt.
definitions.introduced_after_repair: Code is absent before a repair transition and present afterward.
